prompt_text: All in one fundraising and CRM solution
aio_text:
AI Overview
Top all-in-one fundraising and CRM solutions for nonprofits include Givebutter (free, modern), Giveffect (10-in-1 automation), CharityEngine (built-in payments), and GivingFuel.
Top All-in-One Solutions:
- Givebutter: free CRM with built-in engagement.
- Giveffect: combines 10 systems.
- CharityEngine: recurring giving tools.
note: DonorDock NOT cited despite all-in-one being core.
